# Pinned base images for alpen-publish-ecr.yml (STR-4483).
#
# Format: <image as written in the Dockerfile> <multi-arch index digest>
# .github/scripts/pin_base_images.py rewrites each FROM line to these digests
# and fails the build if a Dockerfile uses an image that is not listed here.
#
# To bump one: docker buildx imagetools inspect <image>, copy the top-level
# Digest, and open a PR. Read from alpen-main only, whatever ref is built.
